title: The Geography of Violence
overview: A culminating triptych/trilogy of three shorts , Siobhan, St Pancras Sunrise Short, The Wolf 30 minutes long exploring violence against women across all landscapes, rural, urban -institutional and the home. And women's responses, though structured around hope, it also dramatizes the epidemic of violence as a omnipresent force not  isolated incidents. It also shows tragedy, increasing strength of women and a gripping unbearable tension.
